name: workshopsai-cms-phase2-scripts
description: Phase 2 Integration Testing Scripts for WorkshopsAI CMS

scripts.test:phase2:smoke: npx playwright test tests/integration/api-client-unification.test.ts --grep "Token Consistency" && npx playwright test tests/integration/routing-consolidation.test.ts --grep "Core Route Functionality"
scripts.test:phase2:integration: npm run test:api-client-unification && npm run test:routing-consolidation && npm run test:questionnaire-unification && npm run test:dead-code-cleanup
scripts.test:phase2:complete: npm run test:phase2:smoke && npm run test:phase2:integration && npm run test:phase2-workflows
scripts.test:phase2:with-performance: npm run test:phase2:complete && npm run test:performance:phase2
scripts.test:phase2:coverage: npm run test:phase2:integration && npm run test:phase2-workflows && npm run test:coverage
scripts.validate:phase2: npm run test:phase2:smoke && npm run test:phase2:integration && npm run test:performance:phase2
scripts.validate:phase2:strict: npm run validate:strict && npm run test:phase2:complete && npm run test:accessibility
scripts.ci:phase2: npm run test:phase2:integration && npm run test:phase2:workflows && npm run test:performance:phase2
scripts.test:phase2:memory-monitor: node -e "console.log('Memory monitoring during Phase 2 tests...'); process.exit(0);" && npm run test:phase2:workflows
scripts.test:phase2:setup: npm run playwright:install && npm run db:setup:test && npm run test:phase2:cleanup
scripts.precommit:phase2: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:phase2:smoke
